title: allionia aggregata var. hirsuta
intro: Allionia aggregata var. hirsuta, commonly known as hairy globemallow, is a plant species in the mallow family that is native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. The plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of hairy globemallow include pain relief, wound healing, and the treatment of gastrointestinal issues, among others. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
